$comment: Logo usage rules. 'official' rules are stated or shown in the guidelines; 'provisional' rules are engineering defaults awaiting brand-team confirmation.

official.rule: Do not stretch, distort, or rotate the logo.
Always use the logo in its approved forms and colors, keeping its original proportions.
Do not recolor any part: the bars stay blue or white, the dot stays #FF6600, the positive tagline stays #1A1A1A.
official.evidence: Incorrect Logo Usage shows orange bars, white or blue dots, a blue tagline and all-black symbols, each struck through

official.rule: Never place the lockup or symbol on a brand-orange background or orange circle.
official.evidence: Incorrect Logo Usage, orange panel and orange circle struck through

official.rule: Never use a black circle container or monochrome black artwork.
official.evidence: Incorrect Logo Usage, black circle and black symbols struck through

official.rule: Reversed artwork on brand blue; positive artwork on white or light surfaces; symbol may sit in a blue or white circle badge.
Official artwork is always the exact source file, composited after generation. It is never requested from, redrawn by, or edited by an image model.
official.evidence: Implied by 'approved forms and colors'; mandated by product rules

provisional.rule: Keep two orange-dot diameters of clear space on every side; nothing salient (text, face, subject edge) enters it.
Lockup at least 240px wide on a 1080px canvas (tagline legibility); symbol at least 44px wide.
Do not add a plate, box or rectangle behind the logo to rescue contrast. Choose another variant, another zone, or repair the creative.
Render at 100% opacity, no blend modes, no shadows or glows applied to the artwork.

On photographic or dark-neutral backgrounds a variant is allowed only if local contrast passes (WCAG 3:1 against the artwork's main fill across the clear-space box) and the zone is quiet; log as 'engineering-default'.
